name: Aspen Dental
desc:
Bilingual Scheduling Center Agent | $17/hr plus monthly bonuses | Inbound Scheduling Calls with Appointment Goals
Company: Aspen Dental
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Aspen Dental has over 1,000 dental offices and works to make dental care easier to afford and access. In this role, you're the first voice new patients hear when they call, in English or Spanish. You'll answer a high volume of inbound calls, answer questions about Aspen Dental's services, and book appointments. You'll use trained sales and customer service techniques to help callers say yes to an appointment, and you'll have individual and team goals for appointments set. Training is virtual, and both full-time and part-time shifts are available.

Soft Skills
- Fluent, professional English and Spanish
- Empathy and patience
- Active listening
- Confidence guiding callers to book
- Staying positive in a busy call center

Full list of remote positions with Aspen Dental: https://careers.aspendental.com/us/en/remote-jobs
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: 1+ years of customer service. Retail, call center, or hospitality preferred.
Preferred Experience: High-volume call center experience

Required Skills:
- Professionally fluent in English and Spanish
- Clear, professional speaking voice
- Wants to succeed in a fast-paced, goal-driven job
- Tech-savvy and able to learn new systems quickly
- Cable or fiber internet, hardwired within 6 feet of the router, at least 100 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload (no WiFi, cellular, or hotspot)
- Quiet, private, HIPAA-compliant workspace
- Some evening and weekend availability

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Speaks Spanish and English fluently and has a year of customer service
- Has worked in retail, a call center, or a restaurant or hotel
- Likes hitting goals and earning bonuses
- Needs full-time or part-time options

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Isn't fluent in both English and Spanish
- Doesn't want any sales or appointment goals
- Can't hardwire their internet or doesn't have cable or fiber
- Can't work some evenings and weekends
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Apply online
2. Speak with a recruiter: a phone interview to talk about the job and answer your questions
3. Interview with the hiring manager. There may also be interviews with other team members.
4. Receive an offer
This is the process from Aspen Dental's careers page. That page calls step 3 an in-person interview, but our earlier notes for this role listed a virtual interview, so confirm with the recruiter. Earlier notes also list a background check after the offer, then virtual training. Applicants with call center experience usually move faster, and time to hire is often 1 to 3 weeks depending on training class dates.

How to make your job application stand out: https://youtu.be/mdHkaU6qFlI

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Bilingual English and Spanish
- Inbound call center
- Appointment scheduling
- Patient scheduling
- Customer service
- High call volume
- Sales and conversion goals
- Healthcare or dental office
- Empathy and active listening
- Scheduling software

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer service experience and how you've used your Spanish at work.
- A caller is nervous about the cost of a dental visit. How would you help them feel comfortable booking?
- How do you stay upbeat when you're taking call after call?
- Tell us about a time you met or beat a goal at work. What was the goal, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you helped an upset customer. What was the problem, what did you do, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $17/hr, plus monthly performance bonuses and pay increases at 90 and 180 days.
-Shift: Full-time and part-time shifts available. Some evening and weekend availability required.
-Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with a generous company match.
-Equipment Provided: Yes. The posting lists only internet and workspace requirements and says you'll use provided technology.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This is a great option for bilingual participants, with bonuses every month and raises at 90 and 180 days. The internet rules are strict, so participants should run a speed test and make sure they can plug straight into the router before applying. Training is virtual. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Bilingual Scheduling Center Agent → Senior Agent or Mentor → Call Center Team Lead → Call Center Supervisor, or move into an office-based patient coordinator role. This role builds bilingual customer service, scheduling, and goal-driven call skills.
training: Discussed in interview- must have full availability
